name: llm_answer_check
title: Check an LLM answer against the source
what_it_tests: Hallucination detection: is a chatbot's answer supported by the store policy, does it contradict the source, or does it not answer the question at all?

supported.instructions: Every claim in the answer is supported by the source text

contradicts.instructions: The answer states something that contradicts the source text

answers.instructions: The answer responds to the question asked

state.source: Full Life Clinic, service information: we are open Monday to Friday, 7am to 7pm, and on Saturdays, 7am to 12pm. Test results are available on the portal within 3 business days.

state.source: Safe Home Insurance summary, Essential Plan: the policy covers fire, lightning and explosion, with compensation of up to $200,000. Electrical damage is covered up to $10,000. Burglary with forced entry is covered up to $15,000, but simple theft (with no signs of forced entry) is not covered. Flood damage is not included in the Essential Plan. The deductible is $1,000 per claim, except for fire, which has no deductible.
